outcome: malondialdehyde (MDA) levels in fetal cord blood
superoxide dismutase (SOD) levels in fetal cord blood
catalase (CAT) levels in fetal cord blood
cohort: The study included 33 depressed mothers and 37 healthy control mothers, and their respective fetuses, from whom fetal cord blood samples were collected.
finding: There was no significant difference in malondialdehyde, superoxide dismutase, and catalase levels in fetal cord blood between the depressed mothers' group and the healthy control group.
